title: Aldi's 2022 Christmas advert recreates Home Alone storyline

segments.description: Medium establishing shot of characters in a bustling airport terminal getting ready for a holiday vacation [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=1)].
Medium close-up shot of a family on an airplane realizing one family member was accidentally left behind [[00:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=10)].
Medium shot of Kevin the Carrot alone in a cozy, festively decorated house watching TV and looking startled [[00:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=20)].
Medium action shot of Kevin setting up elaborate traps and defending the home from an intruder in slapstick fashion [[00:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=34)].
Close-up action shot of Kevin getting caught up in Christmas lights and sparks flying on the dining table [[00:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=47)].
Medium tracking shot of Kevin rushing out the door and disguising himself as a snowman's nose in the yard [[00:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=57)].
Medium shot of Santa Claus arriving in the yard and greeting Kevin with joyful relief [[01:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=67)].
Wide tabletop shot displaying the reunited family celebrating around a grand Christmas feast, concluding the holiday commercial [[01:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQb9U3ylAI4&t=81)].
